title: noc_pipe_rate doc comment still references the deleted compact variant and the queue-row rate glyph
detail: This diff deleted noc_pipe_rate_compact and removed the rate glyph from queue rows, but left the doc claiming both exist. Misleads future readers about a consumer that no longer exists.
recommended_fix: Trim the comment's last sentence to name only the wide/selected pipe rows (the remaining live callers at lines 860/874); drop the compact clause.

title: Queue-depth block text size stays unscaled (raw 14) while every sibling panel text hud-scales
evidence:
draw_text(app, depth_label, rnd.hud(&app.view, QOS_PANEL_X + 10), qos_qd_line_y(&app.view, qd_y, 0) + rnd.hud(&app.view, 3), 14, p.ink_soft_text)
-- sibling (line 355) --
draw_text(app, label, rnd.hud(&app.view, QOS_PANEL_X + 10), y + rnd.hud(&app.view, 3), rnd.hud(&app.view, 16), cols[lane])
detail: The rewrite hud-scaled the block's x/y but kept raw 14 for size (lines 431/439/448). At ×1.25/×1.50 the block renders visibly smaller than the rest of the panel, deviating from the 7.3 single-source scaling doctrine.
recommended_fix: Pass rnd.hud(&app.view, 14) as the size at the three new draw_text call sites (431, 439, 448), matching the panel's other rows.

title: qos_qd_lane_x comment references phantom symbol qos_qd_x0
evidence:
// qos_qd_lane_x — a direction line's lane column x (the dir label sits at
// qos_qd_x0, lanes start 30px in, 34px pitch). Pure — the B1 pin.
detail: No qos_qd_x0 exists anywhere in app/ (grep: only this comment). The dir label's actual x is QOS_PANEL_X + QOS_QD_INDENT. A reader chasing the named anchor finds nothing.
recommended_fix: Rewrite to "the dir label sits at QOS_PANEL_X + QOS_QD_INDENT, lanes start QOS_QD_DIR_W in, QOS_QD_LANE_PITCH pitch".
